# Import data

```{r}
# Raw data
expr <- read.delim("/Users/axelcypres/Google Drive/My Drive/M2 BMC ITSI/DATA ANALYSIS IN IMMUNOLOGY/PROJECT/01_data/Project-H7N9Human.txt",
                   row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
expr <- as.matrix(expr)
dim(expr)
summary(as.numeric(expr))

# Log2
logexpr <- log2(expr + 1)
range(logexpr)

# Metadata
meta <- data.frame(sample = colnames(expr))
parts <- strsplit(meta$sample, "_")
meta$virus     <- sapply(parts, `[`, 1)
meta$time      <- sapply(parts, `[`, 2)
meta$replicate <- sapply(parts, `[`, 3)
table(meta$virus, meta$time)   # replicats number

# variables
mock_name <- "mock"
viruses   <- c("H7N9", "H7N7", "H3N2", "VN1203")
times     <- c("03h", "07h", "12h", "24h")
```

# Differential expression

```{r}
de_test <- function(virus, time) {
  if (max(logexpr) > 30) stop("Les données ne sont pas en log2 !")
  inf  <- logexpr[, meta$virus == virus     & meta$time == time, drop = FALSE]
  mock <- logexpr[, meta$virus == mock_name & meta$time == time, drop = FALSE]
  n1 <- ncol(inf); n2 <- ncol(mock)
  cat(virus, time, ":", n1, "infected vs", n2, "mock\n")
  if (n1 < 2 | n2 < 2) stop("Pas assez d'échantillons pour ", virus, " ", time)

  m1 <- rowMeans(inf); m2 <- rowMeans(mock)
  v1 <- rowSums((inf  - m1)^2) / (n1 - 1)
  v2 <- rowSums((mock - m2)^2) / (n2 - 1)
  sp2   <- ((n1 - 1) * v1 + (n2 - 1) * v2) / (n1 + n2 - 2)
  tstat <- (m1 - m2) / sqrt(sp2 * (1 / n1 + 1 / n2))
  pval  <- 2 * pt(-abs(tstat), df = n1 + n2 - 2)

  data.frame(gene   = rownames(logexpr),
             log2FC = m1 - m2,
             pval   = pval,
             padj   = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))
}

res <- list()
for (v in viruses) for (t in times) {
  nm <- paste(v, t, sep = "_")
  res[[nm]] <- de_test(v, t)
}

# Seuils (à justifier dans le rapport)
FC_cut <- 1      # |log2FC| > 1  = fold change > 2
P_cut  <- 0.05
range(res$H7N9_24h$log2FC)
```

# DEG by virus and time

```{r}
is_deg <- function(d) !is.na(d$pval) & abs(d$log2FC) > FC_cut & d$pval < P_cut
deg <- lapply(res, function(d) d$gene[is_deg(d)])

counts <- data.frame(
  comp = names(res),
  up   = sapply(res, function(d) sum(is_deg(d) & d$log2FC > 0)),
  down = sapply(res, function(d) sum(is_deg(d) & d$log2FC < 0))
)
counts$virus <- sapply(strsplit(counts$comp, "_"), `[`, 1)
counts$time  <- sapply(strsplit(counts$comp, "_"), `[`, 2)
counts$total <- counts$up + counts$down
print(counts)
write.csv(counts, "cc", row.names = FALSE)

p_counts <- ggplot(counts, aes(time, total, fill = virus)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "post-infection time", y = "DEG number",
       title = paste0("DEG (|log2FC| > ", FC_cut,
                      ", p < ", P_cut, ")"))
print(p_counts)
ggsave("figures/03_nombre_DEG.png", p_counts, width = 7, height = 5)

# Version up / down separed
counts_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(counts[, c("virus", "time")], sens = "up",   n =  counts$up),
  data.frame(counts[, c("virus", "time")], sens = "down", n = -counts$down)
)
p_updown <- ggplot(counts_long, aes(time, n, fill = virus)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Post-infection time", y = "DEG number (up > 0, down < 0)",
       title = "DEG up and down")
print(p_updown)
ggsave("figures/04_DEG_up_down.png", p_updown, width = 7, height = 5)
```

# Volcano plots (all viruses)

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

volcano <- function(virus, time, n_labels = 10) {
  d <- res[[paste(virus, time, sep = "_")]]
  d$statut <- "NS"
  d$statut[is_deg(d) & d$log2FC > 0] <- "Up"
  d$statut[is_deg(d) & d$log2FC < 0] <- "Down"
  n_up <- sum(d$statut == "Up"); n_down <- sum(d$statut == "Down")
  d$statut <- factor(d$statut, levels = c("Up", "Down", "NS"),
                     labels = c(paste0("Up (", n_up, ")"), paste0("Down (", n_down, ")"), "NS"))

  # Colours (Up = red, Down = blue, NS = grey)
  cols <- setNames(c("red", "blue", "grey70"), levels(d$statut))

  top <- head(d[d$statut != "NS", ][order(d$pval[d$statut != "NS"]), ], n_labels)

  ggplot(d, aes(log2FC, -log10(pval), color = statut)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-FC_cut, FC_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(P_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top, aes(label = gene), color = "black", size = 3,
                    max.overlaps = 30, box.padding = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
    labs(title = paste0(virus, " vs Mock (", time, ")"),
         x = expression(log[2]~"Fold Change"), y = expression(-log[10]~italic(p)*"-value")) +
    # the same axes for all volcanoes -> allowing for comparison between viruses and over time
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim, ylim = y_lim)
}

# Common axis limits, calculated from the 16 comparisons
x_lim <- range(sapply(res, function(d) range(d$log2FC, na.rm = TRUE)))
y_lim <- c(0, max(sapply(res, function(d) max(-log10(d$pval), na.rm = TRUE))))

# One volcano per virus and per time point (4 viruses x 4 time points = 16 figures)
for (v in viruses) {
  for (t in times) {
    p <- volcano(v, t)
    print(p)
    ggsave(paste0("figures/05_volcano_", v, "_", t, ".png"), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
  }
}
```

# Heatmaps : Is one virus different from the others?

Three complementary heatmaps, with hierarchical clustering of the columns. If a virus stands out, its columns form a separate branch of the dendrogram.

1.  **Samples, one time point at a time**: z-score per gene, UP and DOWN genes kept in separate blocks.
2.  **log2FC of the 16 comparisons**: no z-score, because the sign and magnitude of the log2FC are meaningful.
3.  **Correlation between the 16 signatures**: Pearson correlation of the log2FC values.

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# save in png
save_ph <- function(ph, file, width = 8, height = 8) {
  png(file, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 300)
  grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  dev.off()
}

# Colours : red = UP, blue = DOWN, white = 0
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)

# Colours (virus and time)
ann_colors <- list(
  virus = cols_virus,
  time  = setNames(c("#EEEEEE", "#BBBBBB", "#777777", "#333333"), times)
)

n_top <- 1000   # Maximum number of genes displayed (the most variable ones) for readability
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Heatmap of samples, one time point at a time -------------------------
# Rows = DEG (detected in at least one virus at this time point), columns = samples from this time point (including mock)
# Values = z-score per gene: (expression - mean for the gene) / standard deviation
#   -> we compare the PROFILES of the genes across samples, not their absolute levels
for (t in times) {
  genes_t <- unique(unlist(deg[paste0(viruses, "_", t)]))
  samp_t  <- meta$sample[meta$time == t]
  mat <- logexpr[genes_t, samp_t]
  mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, var) > 0, ]                       # removes constant genes
  mat <- mat[head(order(apply(mat, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE), n_top), ]
  z   <- t(scale(t(mat)))                                    # z-score BY GENE (per row)

  # Gene direction = sign of its average log2FC across the 4 viruses at this time point
  #   average > 0 -> UP (upregulated by infection), average < 0 -> DOWN
  lfc_t <- sapply(viruses, function(v) {
    r <- res[[paste(v, t, sep = "_")]]
    r$log2FC[match(rownames(z), r$gene)]
  })
  up_t <- rownames(z)[rowMeans(lfc_t) >  0]
  dn_t <- rownames(z)[rowMeans(lfc_t) <= 0]

  # We organise the genes: the UP block at the top, the DOWN block at the bottom.
  # Within each block, we group together genes with similar profiles
  # (without ever moving a gene from one block to the other)
  clust_block <- function(g) if (length(g) > 2) g[hclust(dist(z[g, ]))$order] else g
  z <- z[c(clust_block(up_t), clust_block(dn_t)), ]

  ann     <- data.frame(virus = meta$virus[meta$time == t], row.names = samp_t)
  ann_row <- data.frame(Sens = rep(c("UP", "DOWN"), c(length(up_t), length(dn_t))),
                        row.names = rownames(z))

  ph <- pheatmap(z, color = pal, breaks = seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101),
                 cluster_cols = TRUE,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,             # keep the order: UP at the top, DOWN at the bottom
                 gaps_row = length(up_t),          # white line between UP and DOWN
                 show_rownames = FALSE, annotation_col = ann,
                 annotation_row = ann_row,         # UP / DOWN on the left
                 annotation_colors = c(ann_colors["virus"],
                                       list(Sens = c(UP = "red", DOWN = "blue"))),
                 main = paste0("Samples at ", t, " - ", length(up_t), " UP / ",
                               length(dn_t), " DOWN (z-score)"))
  save_ph(ph, paste0("figures/06_heatmap_samples_", t, ".png"), width = 8, height = 7)
}
```

```{r}
# --- 2. Heatmap of log2FC values for the 16 comparisons --------------------------------
# Rows = DEGs in at least one comparison; columns = virus_time
# Values = log2FC vs mock (no z-score: the sign and magnitude are meaningful)
lfc <- sapply(res, function(d) d$log2FC)
rownames(lfc) <- res[[1]]$gene
all_deg <- unique(unlist(deg))
lfc_deg <- lfc[all_deg, ]
lfc_deg <- lfc_deg[head(order(apply(lfc_deg, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE), n_top), ]

ann_comp <- data.frame(virus = sub("_.*", "", colnames(lfc)),
                       time  = sub(".*_", "", colnames(lfc)),
                       row.names = colnames(lfc))

ph_lfc <- pheatmap(lfc_deg, color = pal, breaks = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101),
                   cluster_cols = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE,
                   show_rownames = FALSE, annotation_col = ann_comp,
                   annotation_colors = ann_colors,
                   main = paste0("log2FC vs mock - ", nrow(lfc_deg), " the most variable genes"))
save_ph(ph_lfc, "figures/07_heatmap_log2FC_all.png", width = 9, height = 9)
```

```{r}
# --- 3. Correlation between the 16 signatures -----------------------------------
# Pearson's correlation of log2FC values (across all DEGs)
# Close to 1 = both viruses modulate the same genes in the same direction
cor_lfc <- cor(lfc[all_deg, ], method = "pearson")

ph_cor <- pheatmap(cor_lfc, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDB863", "#B2182B"))(100),
                   breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 101),
                   cluster_cols = TRUE, cluster_rows = TRUE,
                   display_numbers = TRUE, number_format = "%.2f", fontsize_number = 7,
                   annotation_col = ann_comp, annotation_row = ann_comp,
                   annotation_colors = ann_colors,
                   main = "Correlation of log2FC values across comparisons")
save_ph(ph_cor, "figures/08_heatmap_correlation.png", width = 10, height = 9)

# Table: Correlation between H7N9 and each other virus, at the same time
cor_h7n9 <- sapply(times, function(t)
  sapply(setdiff(viruses, "H7N9"), function(v)
    cor_lfc[paste0("H7N9_", t), paste0(v, "_", t)]))
round(cor_h7n9, 2)
```
